title: 2003 NASA patent for an asymmetric barrel-shaped capacitor
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2003 NASA patent for an asymmetric barrel-shaped capacitor, about 2003 at NASA / University of Alabama Huntsville, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Larry Smalley on a NASA asymmetric capacitor patent

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that NASA, the US space agency, holds a patent from around 2003 for an asymmetrical barrel-shaped capacitor, a device that stores electric charge, and he links it to the University of Alabama in Huntsville. He connects it to earlier work by people he names, including Larry Smalley and Townsend Brown. If true, it would suggest NASA has looked into electric ways of moving craft like those described in UFO reports.
